source.version: v3.19.0 release surface at main commit 1faf13affb74fb9b1c8598b0ad0cf3a2d7fc4279; unreleased reviewer updates present

capabilities.title: Reachable Nexus research routing and INTEL paper surface
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README architecture and four-skill pipeline
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The integration stays inside the protected Feynman tool and reachable INTEL/VAULT surfaces instead of importing a second Claude-specific host runtime.

capabilities.title: Structured paper search with field, date, citation-count, and methodology filters
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Deep Research search and literature modes

capabilities.title: Citation and URL extraction into a bounded evidence ledger
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Citation verification and reference-management workflow

capabilities.title: Methodology critique covering sample size, confounds, statistics, and replication posture
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Deep Research review mode and Academic Paper Reviewer methodology mode

capabilities.title: Evidence-based reproducibility posture without claiming an experiment was replayed
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Artifact reproducibility lock and methodology review

capabilities.title: Evidence-audited literature gap analysis
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Lit-review mode, novelty guidance, and literature-review gap/future-direction structure
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Observed coverage gaps remain distinct from possible research opportunities and include competing explanations rather than automatic novelty claims.

capabilities.title: Deep research, literature review, fact-oriented audit, comparison, review, draft, recipe, and watch modes
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README operational modes and MODE_REGISTRY.md
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus maps compatible modes into ten protected Feynman workflows; exact upstream mode parity remains split into the pending rows below.

capabilities.title: Claim-level support verdicts tied to directly read source IDs
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Claim verification, citation risk, and integrity-gate behavior

capabilities.title: Deterministic research-integrity passport on every workflow result
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Material Passport, integrity gates, data-access metadata, and process receipts

capabilities.title: Fail-closed experiment declaration and bounded provenance intake
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Experiment Provenance Intake and shared/handoff_schemas.md
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus records operator-supplied evidence only. It never runs or validates the experiment itself, and mismatched experiment-backed claims become unverifiable.

capabilities.title: Reproducibility metadata with an explicit no-replay guarantee
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Artifact Reproducibility Lockfile and shared/artifact_reproducibility_pattern.md

capabilities.title: Visible data-access and task-type annotation
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Data Access Level Metadata and Task Type Annotation
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Feynman stages disclose raw operator/source input while deterministic support policy permits only directly read evidence to support a claim; outcome-gradable workflows remain distinct from open-ended synthesis.

capabilities.title: Cross-model posture receipt without false independent-verification claims
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Canonical Cross-Model Handoff Envelope
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The current passport truthfully reports not_run and independentVerification false. The actual blind handoff envelope remains pending.

capabilities.title: Human approval gates before execution, recurrence, publication, or external writes
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README human-in-the-loop stance and Architecture checkpoints

capabilities.title: Measured variant, threshold, evidence, and operator-decision contracts for runtime experiments
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Benchmark Report Schema

capabilities.title: Local report, provenance, preview, and PDF artifacts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Academic Paper formatting/export and pipeline artifact output

capabilities.title: PRISMA systematic-review protocol with screening flow and exclusion receipts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Deep Research systematic-review mode
capabilities.reason: Nexus has literature review and source coverage receipts but no PRISMA-specific protocol, screening ledger, or flow artifact.

capabilities.title: Socratic research-question and writing-plan dialogue
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Deep Research socratic mode and Academic Paper plan mode
capabilities.reason: Current Feynman commands accept a bounded topic directly and do not run a dedicated question-refinement dialogue with resumable decisions.

capabilities.title: Role-specialized academic research and writing agent team
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README 13-agent Deep Research and 12-agent Academic Paper teams
capabilities.reason: Nexus uses four auditable stages and a separate bounded central orchestrator; it does not yet expose the useful academic role specializations or their artifact handoffs.

capabilities.title: Operator-authored style calibration and academic writing-quality checks
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Academic Paper Style Calibration and Writing Quality Check
capabilities.reason: The Feynman draft contract preserves evidence and uncertainty but does not learn an operator's academic style profile or run a dedicated writing-quality rubric.

capabilities.title: Traceable revision, citation-format conversion, rebuttal audit, disclosure, and submission-package checks
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Academic Paper eleven-mode inventory
capabilities.reason: Nexus produces drafts and revision checklists but lacks deterministic patch application, citation-style conversion, rebuttal traceability, disclosure generation, and submission-package verification.

capabilities.title: Visualization generation and VLM-backed figure verification
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Academic Paper visualization and VLM figure verification
capabilities.reason: The current Feynman workflow does not generate or independently inspect paper figures; adding it requires an explicit image/model boundary and rendered evidence tests.

capabilities.title: Multi-perspective reviewer panel, re-review traceability, and measured FNR/FPR calibration
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Academic Paper Reviewer six modes and calibration protocol
capabilities.reason: Nexus has one Reviewer stage with severity findings but no isolated reviewer panel, gold-set calibration, repeated scoring, or round-to-round traceability matrix.

capabilities.title: Three-layer citation locators and claim-to-passage faithfulness audit
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README v3.7-v3.8 locator and claim-audit behavior
capabilities.reason: Nexus verifies claims against directly read source IDs but does not yet retain passage-level locator anchors or refetch them for claim-faithfulness adjudication.

capabilities.title: Ten-stage research-to-publication pipeline with adaptive checkpoints, score trajectory, and process summary
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Academic Pipeline and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
capabilities.reason: The protected Feynman engine has four research stages and local artifacts, not the full research, write, integrity, review, revision, finalization, and collaboration-quality pipeline.

capabilities.title: Per-stage economy and quality-boost model tiering
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Model Tiering
capabilities.reason: Feynman stages use the existing Nexus AI spine but do not yet choose lower or frontier tiers by execution-versus-judgment role with a visible routing receipt.

capabilities.title: Machine-stable blind cross-model handoff with divergence and malformed-result routing
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Canonical Cross-Model Handoff Envelope and shared/cross_model_verification.md
capabilities.reason: The integrity passport reports that independent verification did not run. Nexus does not yet have a Feynman-specific blind external-model handoff envelope or consent boundary.

capabilities.title: Claude Code plugin installer, slash-command host, hooks, and provider-specific dispatch runtime
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README installation and .claude-plugin packaging
capabilities.reason: Nexus is the host application and already owns protected tool routing, provider access, local continuity, and approval policy. Importing a second Claude-specific host runtime would fragment those controls.

capabilities.title: Copy upstream prompts, templates, schemas, and agent files into Nexus MIT source
capabilities.sourceEvidence: LICENSE and repository prompt/template trees
capabilities.reason: The source is CC BY-NC 4.0 while Nexus is MIT and free for unrestricted use. Nexus independently implements general workflow ideas without copying licensed expression.

capabilities.title: Require Anthropic or another paid cloud model as the academic workflow runtime
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README prerequisites and performance/cost guidance
capabilities.reason: Nexus preserves local-first and BYOK operation through its existing AI spine and cannot make a paid provider mandatory.
